pairs.before: 入队类 API 方法只能经 src/actions/ 的入队动作层调用（统一封装乐观占用打标与去重提示）。
pairs.after: Enqueue API methods must be called only through the src/actions/ enqueue action layer (centralizing optimistic occupancy markers and deduplication notices).

pairs.before: 模型能力只能经 useModelCapabilities 消费（单一真相源 + 统一失效时机）。
pairs.after: Model capabilities must be consumed only through useModelCapabilities (one source of truth and coordinated invalidation).

pairs.before: 禁止整模块 mock：API 打桩用 vi.spyOn(API, method)；i18n 用全局 setup 已加载的真实中文资源（整体 mock 后翻译缺失无法被发现）。
pairs.after: Do not mock entire modules: stub API calls with vi.spyOn(API, method); use the real Chinese i18n resources loaded by global setup (whole-module mocks hide missing translations).

pairs.before: 不要丢弃 refreshProject 的结算值：写入后的刷新改用 canvas/shared/refreshAfterWrite，加载与同步路径传 onError 或按结算值处理。
pairs.after: Do not discard refreshProject settlement results: use canvas/shared/refreshAfterWrite after writes; loading and synchronization paths must pass onError or handle settlement results.

pairs.before: 禁止视口高度（h-screen、min-h-screen、max-h-screen、100vh）：高度由外壳的滚动契约分配，组件用 flex / grid 与 min-h-0 取得剩余空间。
pairs.after: Do not use viewport heights (h-screen, min-h-screen, max-h-screen, 100vh): the shell scrolling contract allocates height; components use flex / grid and min-h-0 for remaining space.

pairs.before: 禁止手写 fixed inset-0 浮层：改用 components/ui 的 Dialog、Sheet 等原语。
pairs.after: Do not handwrite fixed inset-0 overlays: use primitives such as Dialog and Sheet from components/ui/.

pairs.before: 禁止手写 fixed inset-0 浮层：改用 components/ui 的 Dialog、Sheet 等原语。
pairs.after: Do not handwrite fixed inset-0 overlays: use primitives such as Dialog and Sheet from components/ui/.

pairs.before: 禁止读写 scrollHeight 手动测高：自动撑高用统一的输入框原语，滚动区高度交给布局分配。
pairs.after: Do not read or write scrollHeight for manual height measurement: use shared input primitives for automatic growth and layout allocation for scroll-region height.

pairs.before: 业务组件禁用视口断点前缀（sm: / md: / lg: / xl: / 2xl:）：外壳内一律用容器查询（@container 与 @md: 等），确需按视口切换的文件登记进 VIEWPORT_BREAKPOINT_ALLOWLIST。
pairs.after: Business components must not use viewport breakpoint prefixes (sm: / md: / lg: / xl: / 2xl:): use container queries (@container, @md:, etc.) inside shells; register files genuinely requiring viewport switches in VIEWPORT_BREAKPOINT_ALLOWLIST.

pairs.before: 禁用 motion-safe: / motion-reduce: 前缀：减少动态效果由 index.css 的全局规则统一处理，组件直接写动效类。
pairs.after: Do not use motion-safe: / motion-reduce: prefixes: global index.css rules handle reduced motion centrally; components write animation classes directly.

pairs.before: 滚动容器（overflow-auto、overflow-*-auto、overflow-*-scroll）须是定位元素：在同一个字符串里写 relative（已是 absolute、fixed、sticky 的除外），否则绝对定位的子元素会撑出文档滚动。
pairs.after: Scroll containers (overflow-auto, overflow-*-auto, overflow-*-scroll) must be positioned: include relative in the same string (unless already absolute, fixed, or sticky), or absolutely positioned children can expand document scrolling.

pairs.before: 禁止在组件里写滚动条样式（scrollbar-none、no-scrollbar、[scrollbar-width:*]、::-webkit-scrollbar 等）：滚动条始终可见，样式只在 index.css 定义。
pairs.after: Do not write scrollbar styles in components (scrollbar-none, no-scrollbar, [scrollbar-width:*], ::-webkit-scrollbar, etc.): scrollbars remain visible and styles are defined only in index.css.

pairs.before: 调用处不写数值层级（z-10、z-[…]）：弹层、提示、引导分别由原语自带的 z-overlay、z-toast、z-onboarding 负责；#app-root 是独立层叠上下文（isolation: isolate），挂在 body 上的 Portal 总在应用之上。应用内吸顶的工具栏用 z-sticky。
pairs.after: Do not write numeric stacking levels at call sites (z-10, z-[…]): primitives own z-overlay/z-toast/z-onboarding for overlays, toasts, and onboarding respectively; #app-root has an independent stacking context (isolation: isolate), so body-mounted Portals stay above the application. Use z-sticky for sticky in-app toolbars.

pairs.before: 不使用背景模糊（backdrop-blur-*）：弹层遮罩用 bg-scrim，表面用 bg-popover 加 shadow-overlay。半透明表面的文字对比度会随背后画面变化，背景模糊在大面积重绘时开销也大。
pairs.after: Do not use backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-*): overlays use bg-scrim; surfaces use bg-popover plus shadow-overlay. Text contrast on translucent surfaces varies with the picture behind it, and backdrop blur is expensive during large repaints.

pairs.before: 时长与缓动只用 token：duration-fast（150ms）、duration-base（200ms）、ease-emphasized。动效不超过 300ms；弹层进出场用原语自带的 animate-in、animate-out，持续运行的状态指示用 animate-breath。
pairs.after: Use tokens only for duration and easing: duration-fast (150ms), duration-base (200ms), ease-emphasized. Animations must not exceed 300ms; overlay entrance/exit uses primitive animate-in/animate-out, and continuously running status indicators use animate-breath.

pairs.before: 多行输入用 components/ui/textarea 的 Textarea：随内容撑高、超过上限后框内滚动、variant 与 mono 都由原语提供。必须使用原生 textarea 的场景（如与着色镜像层同步滚动的编辑器），行内 eslint-disable-next-line 并写明理由。
pairs.after: Use components/ui/textarea Textarea for multiline input: it grows with content, scrolls internally above its limit, and provides variant and mono. When native textarea is required (e.g. editors synchronizing scrolling with syntax-highlight mirrors), add an inline eslint-disable-next-line with a reason.

pairs.before: 全局提示统一用 useAppStore 的 pushToast：ToastOverlay 负责把 store 中的提示按到达顺序转交 Base UI 队列，直接调用 toast.add 会绕过它，也绕过提示、工作区通知与持久告警的分流（见 src/stores/app-store.ts 中 pushToast 的说明）。
pairs.after: Use useAppStore pushToast for global notices: ToastOverlay forwards store notices to the Base UI queue in arrival order. Direct toast.add bypasses this and the routing between toasts, workspace notifications, and persistent alerts (see pushToast in src/stores/app-store.ts).

pairs.before: components/ui/ 只放 shadcn CLI 安装的原语：调用 API、读写 store 或依赖业务类型的组件放进使用它的业务目录，多处共用的放 components/shared/。knip 对 components/ui 的未使用导出整体豁免，业务组件混进来后，它真正未使用的导出也会被放过。
pairs.after: components/ui/ contains only shadcn CLI-installed primitives: components calling APIs, reading/writing stores, or depending on business types belong in their consuming business directories; shared ones belong in components/shared/. knip exempts unused exports throughout components/ui/, so misplaced business components would hide truly unused exports.

pairs.before: components/ui/ 内跨目录导入用不含 .. 的 @/ 别名：带 .. 的路径绕过原语依赖边界的检查。
pairs.after: Use @/ aliases without .. for cross-directory imports within components/ui/: paths containing .. bypass primitive dependency-boundary checks.

pairs.before: 页面级场景不手写动画等待：用 e2e/support/region-helpers.ts 的 waitForEntrance，或交给 defineRegionScenarios 探测前的统一等待。
pairs.after: Do not handwrite animation waits in page scenarios: use waitForEntrance from e2e/support/region-helpers.ts or the shared prescan wait in defineRegionScenarios.
